title: 原声 → 嵌入水印（embed，5.6s）
description: embed 任务演示：原始干净语音（AV-Deepfake1M val）→ 水印信号 x̃（PESQ≈4.6，听感无差异）。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。对比输入输出音频验证透明度；对 x̃ 再跑 verify 会得到 AUTHENTIC/verified。原始录音（未嵌水印）：verify 判 UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（fail-safe 报警侧——与水印死亡不可区分）。也可作为 embed 任务的输入素材。
